purpose: 原E83已纠正旧审批遗漏，E84在网络/金融前登记有限直接旧用途读取与企业运营资金原问题来源路线。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def receipt(rel):
 p=ROOT/rel;assert p.is_file(),'有限旧用途输入缺少：'+rel
 return {'path':rel,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
files=['research/historical_index_liquidity_transmission_v1.py','research/registered_factors.py','research/round2_mechanism_factors.py','research/factor96_library_intake_v1.py','config/factor_registry.yaml','config/factor_registry_round2.yaml','config/factor_registry_round3.yaml','config/factor_registry_round4.yaml','docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md','config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json','reports/research/510300_banker_loan_approval_daily_v1/protocol.json','reports/research/510300_banker_loan_approval_daily_v1/result.json','reports/research/510300_multidim_shared_evidence_attribution_v1/E2_旧来源复用核对.json','reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_joint_score_v1/研究准入纠正_旧审批方向已冻结.json','reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_joint_score_v1/next_experiment.json']
pattern=re.compile('资金周转|销货款回笼|企业家问卷|企业家调查|working.?capital|cash.?collection|entrepreneur',re.I)
rows=[]
for rel in files:
 p=ROOT/rel;raw=p.read_bytes();s=raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
 matches=[{'position':m.start(),'context':s[max(0,m.start()-300):min(len(s),m.end()+450)]} for m in pattern.finditer(s)]
 rows.append({**receipt(rel),'full_text_read':True,'all_target_alias_contexts':matches})
quarters=[f'{y}Q{q}' for y in range(2018,2026) for q in range(1,5) if (y,q)>=(2018,3) and (y,q)<=(2025,3)]
assert len(quarters)==29
proto={'study_id':'510300_ENTERPRISE_WORKING_CAPITAL_ORIGINAL_QUESTION_AND_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E84','registered_at':now(),'status':'REGISTERED_DIFFERENT_ENTERPRISE_WORKING_CAPITAL_PRIOR_USE_AND_SOURCE_ONLY',
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_CORRECTED_MISCLASSIFIED_PRIOR_USE_AND_STOPPED_DUPLICATE_FIELD_RESEARCH',
 'hypothesis':'借款需求可来自扩张或周转困难；企业运营资金周转的原主观回答可能提供不同于银行需求/审批的企业资金压力信息。先核确切原问题和不同旧用途，不能预设解释必然成立。',
 'target_object_not_yet_authenticated':'央行企业家问卷资金周转问题的当季原扩散指数；原字段/定义/调查母体由原报告核实，不能用银行问卷、个股现金流、盈利或销货款回笼列替换。',
 'target_quarters':quarters,'first_source_route':'官方搜索只找央行企业家实际目录/原发布页；随后只跟随真实目录分页和该季度原附件。禁止猜分页、用后期历史回引或替换字段。',
 'budget':{'official_search_queries_max':4,'additional_primary_web_opens_max':4,'actual_catalog_pages_GET_max':18,'release_pages_GET_max':29,'original_current_PDF_GET_max':29,'target_network_retries':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0},
 'prior_use_full_reads':rows,
 'prior_use_rule':'直接读取本范围中有实质同字段金融用途的旧决策直链协议/结果；存在同原字段/同金融用途冻结则结束。最新提案/原因术语出现不是旧金融使用，同份原件重取、模型替换不能作为新经济信息。有限范围不宣称全部repo穷尽。',
 'source_contract':'当前29原问题表头/本季值/单位/完整编制方法/调查母体/原显示公布页及真实附件对应；已知晚版本不能绑旧钟。经济季度、访谈期、显示公开钟、本地取得和真正首版分开，未知不造。',
 'original_pool_support':'全部原1711成员及1212当前/成熟训练池保持，不删成员、缩时期或补0。既有未公布新季度仅用此前真实已公布信息；缺失/未合格当前报告不得拖旧状态救回。当前季度和信息龄展示，不冒充每天企业真实现金情况。',
 'financial_registration':'当前金融预算0；只有原问题实质不同且全部来源支持通过，才另题登记唯一候选，不指定符号、窗口、交互或标签改动。',
 'old_bank_demand_and_approval_financial_rejections_remain_frozen':True,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'goal_achieved':False}
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p=OUT/'protocol.json';assert not p.exists() and not (OUT/'result.json').exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(proto,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'已登记':'E84原问题/旧用途/来源资格','当前有限旧用途完整原件':len(rows),'全部别名匹配':[{'path':z['path'],'contexts':z['all_target_alias_contexts']} for z in rows if z['all_target_alias_contexts']],'金融及源码预算':0},ensure_ascii=False))
